answer: Rate limiting at the zephyr: each subnet fingerprint (ASN + /24 prefix) gets 1 attestation per 10-minute epoch. The grove enforces a 50-node cap per fingerprint, so a farm needs 50 distinct ASNs to reach 2,500 identities. The echo of shared timing patterns flags clusters, raising attacker cost to ~$8/ASN/month for negligible yield.
